name: Monster Walk
instructions: Place a band around both ankles and another around both knees. There should be enough tension that they are tight when your feet are shoulder width apart.
To begin, take short steps forward alternating your left and right foot.
After several steps, do just the opposite and walk backward to where you started.
prompt: This is a Monster Walk for strength that uses pull force to primarily train the abductors. These are the instructions that a person would receive: "Place a band around both ankles and another around both knees. There should be enough tension that they are tight when your feet are shoulder width apart. To begin, take short steps forward alternating your left and right foot. After several steps, do just the opposite and walk backward to where you started."
